extracted.name: Sausage Balls
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350ºF (177ºC). Spray a rimmed baking sheet with nonstick spray.
In a bowl, combine flour, salt, and baking powder. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Add sausage, cheese, and milk. Mix by hand until well combined.
Scoop and shape into 1-inch balls, squeezing to hold shape.
Place on baking sheet. Bake 20–25 min until browned.
Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
